text:
marta: Heads-up — we quietly crossed 2M ARR for the month. Not a press release thing, but a big team win. :tada: How does a small IRL celebration sound? ramen cart, cake, tacos, or potted-plant raffle?
liam: Ramen cart > everything. hot broth at 11am please. :ramen:
devon: Plant raffle!!! I will trade a pothos for a sticker. :seedling:
sumit: Ramen + extra spice packets for me. also can we get a quiet gong? small one. :small_gong: (I will not actually bring a gong)
olga: Remote folks would love a virtual sticker pack if we're doing IRL. Also congrats infra team for not letting the queues melt down. @eng-sre :heart:
raina: Quick poll time — pick one: Ramen / Cake / Tacos / Plants. vote in thread, ends in 24h. :ballot_box:
hr-bot: Poll created: Celebrate — Ramen | Cake | Tacos | Plant raffle. Ends 24h. (link: https://polls.internal/company/3467891234)
marta: Love it. Can we also do a tiny noon check-in for a team photo? low-key, no pressure. :camera_with_flash:
devon: +1 for photo and plant swaps. I'll bring labels for plants (allergen note: none, but cats beware). :label: 
liam: I'll make a quick sheet for dietary restrictions. dropping it in #help later.
marta: Shout-out to @sumit and @devon — your late-night queue tuning saved the day. mini kudos: :sparkles: (reacted :tada: by olga)
sumit: team effort. thrilled to see this. also small personal promise: I'll adopt a new desk plant if we do the raffle. :seedling::handshake:
olga: Suggestion: if plants win, do a "plant-parenting 101" 10-min session for new plant owners. I'll run it. :books:
liam: Poll leaning ramen so far. also, if someone wants to DJ low-volume ramen vibes, sign up here. :notes:
hr-bot: Reminder: please RSVP for in-office treats by EOD tomorrow.
marta: OK — wrapping. thanks all. this felt like the kind of quiet, delightful win we want to celebrate together. :confetti_ball:
